scope: Synthetic Space Watch UI plus real-module native grants and live providers; not physical-phone spotting accuracy

Fixture stage list selection gives EAST, 1½ fists up and Saturn anchor
Real same-launch lookup and explicit Wikipedia request render attributed results
Red mode and native touch rewind update the selected-object view
Red preference survives a genuine process restart
Canvas touch selects the ISS, independently of the list
Landscape dome and selected-object details remain operable
200% Android text: dome, scrolling details and close controls remain operable
Native menu pause/resume restores the sky
Real module refuses ungranted phone location and offers manual place
Real manual-place flow works without location, but ungranted HTTP stays denied
Real module: native granted fix and live CelesTrak orbits populate the sky
Real cached sky reopens with Wi-Fi and mobile data disabled
limitations: No physical-device spotting or compass alignment tested
Synthetic position/orbit answers bypass authority; native gates exercised separately with real module

captureNotes: The real-network display capture is rewound 4 min 40 sec after a runner scroll crossed the range control; offline reopen resets to Now. Counts are observations at different sky times, not an equality assertion.
environmentNotes: Emulator Bluetooth service aborted during startup; no Construct fatal exception found in retained crash/runtime logs.
